job.job_description:
Experience : 6 to 15 Years (2+ GenAI & Agentic AI)




Role Objective




We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to build autonomous, multi-agent systems. You will move past simple prompting to engineer stateful, self-correcting workflows that allow LLMs to plan, execute tasks, and use enterprise tools independently.




Responsibilities




Design multi-agent architectures and stateful DAGs using LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen.

Connect LLMs to APIs and build high-performance RAG pipelines using vector databases (Qdrant, Milvus, Pinecone).

Deploy production monitoring (LangSmith/Langfuse), establish LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations, and implement security guardrails.




Technical Stack Required




LangGraph, CrewAI, or Semantic Kernel.

Python or Go/TypeScript.

Docker, Kubernetes, and Cloud AI platforms (AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, or GCP Vertex AI).

ReAct loops, function calling, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
